commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR=$CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR"; git branch --show-current; git status --short | head

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp && : > .prflow/tmp/implement-active-1048
echo "marker written"
echo "--- open PRs referencing 1048 ---"
gh pr list --search "1048 in:body" --state open --json number,headRefName 2>&1
echo "--- dependency preflight ---"
scripts/preflight.py dependencies --issue 1048 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
for s in python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do echo "=== $s ==="; bash lib/test/run-shard.sh "$s" 2>&1 | tail -3; done

ls -d .prflow/tmp/review/*/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l; find .prflow/tmp/review -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | sort > .prflow/tmp/iter-baseline-1048.txt 2>/dev/null; wc -l < .prflow/tmp/iter-baseline-1048.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0

printf 'RUN_ID=%s
' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"
printf 'max_iters=%s
' "$(scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review_and_fix.max_iterations 5 2>/dev/null)"
printf 'fix_threshold=%s
' "$(scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review_and_fix.fix_severity_threshold important 2>/dev/null)"
printf 'verdict_threshold=%s
' "$(scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review.verdict_severity_threshold important 2>/dev/null)"

echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"; scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review_and_fix.max_iterations 5; scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review_and_fix.fix_severity_threshold important; scripts/config-get.sh .prflow_review.verdict_severity_threshold important
git diff main...HEAD -- skills/implement/SKILL.md | grep -c '^[-+]' ; echo "---changeset frontmatter check---"; git grep -h "Writing-skills evidence" $(git rev-parse HEAD) -- . 2>/dev/null | head -1

TRIGGER=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1048/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "trigger_comment=$TRIGGER"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER" ]; then scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER" --reaction hooray 2>&1 | tail -1; fi
rm -f .prflow/tmp/implement-active-1048 2>/dev/null; echo "marker removed"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
